tei:div.tei:p: (177)༄༅// dpal kyai rdo rje'i dbang gi chu bo chen mo mdzes par byed pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba bzhugs so/// /

"$ (178)༄༅// na maḥshrī tsakra nā tha rat+na war+dhā ya/ dpal ldan dges pa rdo rje dang*// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// dbang gi chu bo mdzes pa'i rgyan// blo dman don du bshad kyis nyon// rjes bzung bsnyen pas cho ga dang*// sta gon bri rgyan sgrub cing mchod// 'jug cing dbang blang mjug chog lte// spyi sdom brgyad las dang po gsum// gzhan du shes bya sta gon la// sbyor dngos rjes kyi dang po ni// gang du dkyil 'khor bya ba'i sar// thig chen brgyad dam dkyil 'khor gyi// skya thig rdzogs par btab pa'i dbus// dri yi thig le gru bzhi dang*// phyogs mtshams rnams su zlum po'i steng*// me tog tshom bu re re dgod// de yi dbus su mañji la// sogs pa'i steng du sa lha yi// maṇ+ḍal tshom bu legs par bsham// ras bris ltar na lha dgu yi// tshom bu'ang maṇ+ḍal la bkod de// sa lha 'og dang lha dgu yi// maṇ+ḍal steng du bshams na mdzes// de yi phyi rol byang shar gyi// mtshams su mtshams 'dzin me tog dang*// shar du zhabs bsil zhal bsil gnyis// shar lhor 'thor 'thung lhor mchod yon// lho nub mtshams su me tog dang*// nub tu bdug spos mar me gnyis// nub byang dri chab byang zhal zas// de rnams gru bzhir bshams nang du// shar nub gnyis su lhag re dang*// bcas pa'i phyogs (179)bzhi mtshams bzhi ru// bdug spos mar me zhal zas re// g.yas skor dag tu gru bzhir bshams// sa lha'i maṇ+ḍal nye logs su// gtor ma gcig bshams 'byor byung na// sgos mchod kyang bshams dkyil 'khor gyi// byang shar nas brtsams shar lho'i bar// 'das pa'i lha dang 'jig rten pa'i// gtor ma gnyis sam lnga la sogs// gang dgos bsham zhing logs shig tu// sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma dang*// grub na las kun pa'i mchod pa// me tog la sogs rnam lnga yang*// bshams na legs par bdag gis mthong*// slob dpon mdun du rdor dril dang*// nang mchod gos zung la sogs bsham// mtshan ldan bum pa gnyis sam bcu// legs bkrus kha tshar ma nyams pa'i// ras bzang mgul 'ching prog lnga pa'am// bdun pa legs bcings lha so so'i// g.yas kyi phyag mtshan bris la gdags// gnyis las med na rnam rgyal la// pad+mar gnas pa'i thod pa ni// sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa dang*// gri gug legs gdags las bum la// sna tshogs rdo rje bris te gdags// 'khyil pa bzla zhing gu gul gyis// legs bdug yungs kar dag gis brab// gtsang ma'i chu yis sum gnyis dgang*// nas gro sran 'bras til 'bru(180)lnga// gser dngul byi ru mu tig dang*// mu man zhes bya rin chen lnga// sle tres kaṇ+ḍa shu dag dmar// rgya mtsho lbu pa dbang lag sman// lan tshwa bu ram ro ma dang*// mar dang sbrang rtsi snying po lnga// tsan+dan dkar dmar gur gum dang*// ga bur dzā ti dri bzang lnga// sha lnga bdud rtsi rnam lnga ste// sum cu rtsa lnga ci 'byor gzhug

/ku shas kha brgyan bum gdan steng*// lha yi bkod pa ji bzhin bsham// las bum puk+ka sī'i g.yas bzhag /gnyis las med na rnam rgyal g.yas// las bum g.yon bzhag bzlog pa'ang yod// rnam rgyal steng du dung chos sogs// dri bzang chu yis bkang ba dang*// gzungs thag btags pa'i rdo rje bzhag /slob ma sta gon bya dgos na// nyer spyod so shing khyor chu dang*// dpung skud ku sha sogs bsham mo// zhes te ji skad bshad pa de dag ni dbang gi chu bo chen mo'i dgongs pa tho tsam zhig bkod pa ste/ zhib tu brgyud pa'i phyag len mthong ba las shes par bya'o// dngos gzhi bdag bskyed bzlas mchod rjes// dkyil 'khor bsdus nas sa lha dang*// lha dang bum pa slob ma rnams// lhag par gnas pa rim bzhin bya// zhes te de yang rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod gtor la/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs te/ 'og tu bsang sbyangs zhes 'byung ba rnams su'ang 'di dran par bya'o// de nas gtor ma la lag pa g.yon pa bstan te oṃ/ g.yas pa bstan te āḥ gnyis ka bstan te hūm̐/ lag pa gnyis ni bkan byas la// srin lag gnyis ni phan tshun dkri// gung mo dang ni mtheb rtse sbyar// khro bo gnyis kyis mnan par bya// zhes pa ltar bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan to hoḥ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya las mdzub mo gnyis bkug la/ oṃ ma hā bhu ta sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes pas gtor mgron spyan drangs/ pad skor dang bcas pa'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ in+d+ra dza ma zhes sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ oṃ badz+ra pūṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: zhes sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ ma hā bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa (181)bzhi'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo//

zhes dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis nang mchod phul// rdo rje nu ma g.yas steng bzung*// dril bu snying ga'i thad du dkrol// lag pa nu ma'i steng du bsgyings// sgra ni sku gsung thugs su sgrogs// zhes pa ltar dril bu sum brdung byas la/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ rdo rje snying ga dang dril bu chig brdung byas la/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ zhes sogs kyi rjes su/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kyai rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i ched/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang bar 'tshal na zhes pa tsam mam/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ zhes skabs dang sbyar la/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad srung ba dang sdong grogs mdzod cig /muḥ zhes brjod de lag pa g.yas sa la reg pas gtor mgron rnams sgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su gshegs pa re bsam/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba de dag sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du dengs shig / ces dang*/ āṣ+ṭā bzla zhing rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu drag tu dkrol lo// gtor mgron gyi phyi 'brang gi bgegs rnams ring du bskrad par bsams te/ gtor ma gtsang sar bskyal lo// de nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byas rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i (182)gzhal khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/

mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung*/ mchod yon/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog /zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las grub pa ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi 'chad par gyur/ zhes dang so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra ni wi ti hūm̐ kham̐ swā hā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho khaṃ raṃ ma hā ār+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du thog mtha' gnyis 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ ne wi d+ye/ shab+da 'i bar dang*/ mthar rdo rje snying gar gzung dril bu rgyun dkrol dang rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nyā pa ra mi ta/ nā da swā bhā we/ badz+ra dharma hri da ya/ san+to ṣa ṇi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā// zhes lan gsum brjod de gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ mchod pa rnams kyi phyag rgya ni// khu tshur kha sbyar gung mo gnyis// brkyangs te rtse sbyar chu bzhi'i rgya// khu tshur gyen 'thor me tog gi /thur du blugs pa bdug pa'i 'o// mthe bong gyen bsgreng mar me'i ste// thal mo phyir bstan dri mchog gi /de nyid gyen bkan zhal zas so// se gol gtog pa rol mo'i sgra// zhes pa ltar ro// de nas tshogs pa che zhing slob dpon du 'os pa yod pa dang zhu 'bul byed par spro na/

(183)las kyi slob mas thun mong du phyag gsum byas la/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma phul te/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa dang rig pa 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams la rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin zab mo la gnas par zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// zhes sogs brjod/ phyag gsum byas la slob dpon gyi mdun du me tog gis bkang ba'i snod spos reng dang bcas pa dang*/ gzhan rnams la so sor me tog re phul/ phyag gsum byas la 'greng ste 'dud pa dang bcas pa'am/ pus mo sa la btsugs pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te/ kun bzang rnam 'phrul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod pa dang*// yon bdag bgegs zhi tshogs gnyis rdzogs bya'i phyir// gnyis med ting 'dzin dag la gnas par mdzod/ ces lan gsum brjod cing re re'i mthar me tog re gtor/ phyag gsum byas la slob dpon me tog gi gzhan rnams las me tog re bsdu/ phyag gsum byas la thams cad kyis thun mong du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bzhu/ zhes bskul te tshogs pa thams cad kyi bla ma la tshogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa slob dpon gyi drung du gzhug /slob dpon gyis kyang me tog tshom bu de nyid kyi steng du slar yang me tog bsnan la maṇ+ḍal phul te/ ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// zhes sogs brjod/ las kyi slob mas maṇ+ḍal rten gyi drung sogs gang rigs su bzhag ste/ phyag gsum byas la rang nyid gral la 'dug go / de dag gi sdom ni/ phyag gsum btsal la maṇ+ḍal dbul// phyag gsum btsal la me tog dgram// phyag gsum btsal la zhu 'bul bya// phyag gsum btsal la me tog bsdu// phyag gsum btsal la maṇ+ḍal bskul// phyag gsum btsal la (184)gral la 'dug

/ces pa ltar ro/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te rdzogs rim gyi rjes su dag pa dran pa dang bzlas pa bya ba'i bar bdag bskyed yan lag drug pa bzhin rdzogs par bsgom la bzlas pa'i rjes su/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur tu phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub snying po kye rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes pa'i mthar yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la zhes sogs gong bzhin las/ rol mo rnams dngas shing thog pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur zhes dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ nī rī zhes sogs nas shap+da 'i bar gong ltar brjod/ 'di man gyi mchod pa byin brlabs thams cad 'di bzhin go bar bya'o// de nas pad skor sngon du 'gro bas so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā zhes sogs nas shap+da 'i bar 'don la kha bsgyur ba'i phyi mchod/ hūm̐ am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo zhes pas nang mchod/ thal mo sbyar te/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis yid mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// sogs kyis bstod pa rnams byas la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu ste srung pa'i 'khor lo la thim zhes pa nas/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la thim/ yum yab la thim/ zhal phyag lhag ma rnams rtsa ba'i zhal phyag la thim/ rang he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par gyur zhes brjod pas dkyil 'khor bsdu'o//

de nas sa lha'i sgos mchod yod dmar me la sogs pa spar te mchog dang 'brel na sngar nam mkhar bteg pa'i (185) sa'i lha mo mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du byon par bsam nas/ de la mchod gtor phul ba tsam gyis chog la/ de dang ma 'brel na tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pām̐ las pad+ma dang āḥlas zla ba'i steng du bam̐ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhi ba'i nyams can/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis bklubs pa/ phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang khu tshur gnyis dpung mgor bsnol te se gol gyi sgra byas nas mdzub mo gnyis lcags kyu ltar bkug pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ 'og nas rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgya zhes 'byung ba rnams su 'di dran par par bya'o// oṃ badz+ra go rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sogs bzhis dgug gzhug gcing dbang bya/ de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ khu tshur g.yon gyi mthe chung dang*// g.yas pa'i mdzub sbrel lcags kyu ste// khu tshur rgyab sbyar zhags mig ltar// byas pa zhags pa'i phyag rgya'o// mthe chung mdzub mo phan tshun du// so sor sbrel ba lcags sgrog yin// khu tshur bcangs pa'i 'khrigs ma gnyis// bsnol ba'i rgyab sbyar dril bu'o// zhes pa ste 'og tu go rī la sogs pa'i sngags rgya zhes 'byung ba rnams su'ang 'di rnams dran par bya'o// slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba bstsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa ābhi ṣiñca hūm̐// zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag
/chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ oṃ pri thi wī de wi

zhes pa so so'i mgor sbyar ba'i nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swā hā/ zhes sogs nas (186)shab+da 'i bar dang*/ ghan+dhe ra nī rol chen dang mchod pas mchod/ gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum gyi mthar/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes brjod/ lag pa g.yas pa mchog sbyin byas la/ oṃ pri thi wā+-i de wī oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs lan gsum se gol dang bcas pas phul/ rdor dril 'dzin pas tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su rdo rje gsor dril bu bcad gtubs su dkrol la/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// kye yi rdo rje khros mchod pa'i// lha mo khyod ni dbang du gyur// sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri// zhes lan gsum brjod/ spro na rdo rje snying gar bzung dril bu chig brdung byas la/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang zhes sogs gong bzhin las 'tshal na zhes pa'i mthar sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar gyis shig / ces gnang ba thos par bsam/ lag pa g.yas sa la reg ste/ oṃ badz+ra muḥsa'i lha mos de nyid la thim zhes brjod la// sa lha'i tshom bu dang mchod gtor dman pa rnams bsdu'o// lha sta gon ni tshom bu bkod ma tshar ba dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi dri bzang gis byug pa dang bstun te/ oṃ me di ni badz+ra bha wa bhan+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces dang*/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas sa phyogs der srung ba'i 'khor lo dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa skad cig gis bsam/ der me tog gcig bzhag la de'i nang du gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa'ang skad cig gis bskyed la/

so so'i tshom bu bkod pa dang bstun nas lha rnams 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bskyed pas kyang rung la/ phyag len la bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las (187)pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes pa nas mi ri rab tu 'bar bas gang bar gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa zhes sogs kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs kha che ba gyen du bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa/ de'i nang du yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du pam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams rang gi sems kyi snang bar ro gcig tu 'dres pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang*/ zhes sogs sam/ yang na dbang chu chen mo las srung 'khor dang gzhal yas khang gi bar 'bring gi mngon rtog bzhin bsgom zhes gsung pa'i don/ chos 'byung gi nang du 'byung bzhi bskyed pa nas ho dmar po gnyis kyis mtha' brten pa'i bar do'i rnam par shes pa zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod nas/ de rnams 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim ste thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa las zhes sogs kyis bskyed de 'di ltar byas na legs so// gong ltar yang de man chad 'dra bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang zhes pa nas rgyan du mas brgyan pa zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ steng gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu brgyad shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/

gzhan yang chu brgyad/ me brgyad/ mchod rten brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ro dang (188)ro langs la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang pa'i nang gi lha snam shar dkar zhes pa nas thags zangs ris dud ka rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan dang bcas par gyur// zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas hūm̐ shrī he badz+ra nā ma dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po/ zhes pa nas/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ ces pa'i bar dang*/ naṃ nai rāt+ma na ma/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje bdag med ma/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ gam̐ gau rī na ma/ shar du gau ri nag mo g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ zhes dang*/ de bzhin du tsam̐ tsau rī nā ma/ lhor tsau rī/ bam̐ be tā lī nā ma/ nub tu be tā lī/ gham̐ ghasma rī nā ma/ byang du ghasma ri/ pam̐ puk+ka sī nā mā/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ sham̐ sha wa rī nā ma/ shar lhor ri khrod ma/ lam̐ tsāṇ+ḍa lī nā ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ ḍam̐ ḍam̐ bi nī nā ma/ nub byang du g.yung mo zhes sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra zhes mtshan sngags lan cig sbyar ba'i ni ri hūm̐ kham̐ swā hā/ zhes sogs nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod la/

gau rī la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa/ bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī sogs nas shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod de/ ye shes pa dang dbang lha'i mchod (189) pa dmigs bsal ma gtogs 'og ma rnams la'ang 'di bzhin shes par bya'o// de nas bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ zhes sogs nas khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+rā bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gnyis gau rī dang zhes sogs nas ghasma rī dang ḍom+bi nī la 'od dpag med pas dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ de nas mar me la sogs pa sbar la/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab nas mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang tha mi dad par bsams la/ dku g.yon par khu tshur gnyis steng 'og tu kha sbyar te/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di// bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ oṃ bha ga wān zhes sogs brjod cing phyag rgya dkrol te rnam lnga 'dod skor sngon du 'gro bas gong du bshad pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ nī ri hūm̐ kham̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing mthar se gol gtogs/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags kyi thog mtha' dang phyag rgya rnams 'dra ba las/ lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal bsil 'di// oṃ badz+ra ni wi te hūm̐ kham̐ swā hā/ lha rdzas dam pa'i 'thor 'thung 'di/ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ kham̐ ram̐ ma hā ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas chu bzhi dbul/

de bzhin du me tog la sogs pa so so'i phyag rgya byas te/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa// bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi// bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ oṃ bha ga wān zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra pūṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du gzhan rnams 'dra ba las/ tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang*// gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /bdag gis sogs gong bzhin las/ dhū pe= /srin po 'joms shing dag byed la// dge zhing mun pa (190)rnams sel ba/ ā lo ke= /'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste// dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ ghān+dhe= /sman rnams bcud gtsang yi gar 'ong*// sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /nai wi d+ya= /dri med yid du 'ong ba yi// lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di// bcom ldan sogs dang shab+da 'i mthar rol chen rgyun dkrol du bya ste/ ghān+dhe ra ṇi sogs brjod/ gos zung bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa/ 'jam pa/ yang ba/ dngas shing thogs pa med pa zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang*// srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ bha ga wān zhes sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra waṣ+ṭa ya āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes brjod cing pad skor sngon du 'gro ba'i khu tshur gnyis kyis na bza' blangs te thog mar smad g.yogs dang de nas stod g.yogs 'bul ba'i tshur bya zhing lha re re la phul bar bsam mo// de nas g.yon pa'i srin lag gis nang mchod nas blangs te mthe bo'i rtses gtor la lha thams cad kyi phyag tu thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re byang bar bsams shing*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba/

drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan nas brjod la/ zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod/ de nas rdo rje 'chang/ nas rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi lam 'bras brgyud pa rtsams kyi mtshan nas brjod cing dbul/ gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag mnos/ chos kyi 'brel ba thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas aṣ+ṭa dang*/ de wa pi tsu dang*/ karta ri dang*/ oṃ āḥ.a āḥ(191)i ī sogs dang*/ oṃ ā gam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ āḥḍam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes pa'i bar brjod cing dpal kye rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rang gi lce rtse/ smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam/ sta gon gyi nyin skabs 'dir gtor ma rnams la bar phud bran la/ de nas/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī dharma pā la tsa turmu khā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor srung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing*/ tshon dho dang nye ba'i tshon dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/

rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong*/ pho nya/ 'phrog ma// grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i brtan ma bcu gnyis (192)'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gnas bdag /gzhi bdag /yul bdag /grong bdag /gnyug mar gnas pa rnams dang*/ 'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur tu bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal pa dang ldan par gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang rang gis kyang myur la/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta a mṛ ta swā da na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas dril bu sum brdung bya zhing*/ rang gi snying ga nas lha mo brgyad sprul te mchod par bsams la/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang*/ de rnams kyis bstod par bsams te/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs dang*/ bstod pa nyi shu pa sogs ci shes pas bstod la/ pus mo btsugs te spos dang bcas pa'i rdor dril 'dzin pas/ dril bu bcad gtub tu dkrol zhing*/ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rig pa'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod// dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// mgon po bdag ni 'dre bar 'tshal// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed la mchod par bya ba'i phyir// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa lags// de bas bka' drin mdzad par 'os// 'gro ba 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa'i// sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*// sangs rgyas bstan la dga' ba dang*// gang su rdo rje'i spyan ldan rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis ni// he zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis// 'gro ba (193)dag phyir dag 'dri bas// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad nas kyang*// dkyil 'khor par bcas thams cad kyi// thugs rjes dgongs nas gnang bar mdzod/

ces lan gsum brjod pas/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod gzhan don rgya che bar gyis shig / ces gnang ba thob par bsam/ bum pa sta gon ni/ skabs 'di'am gnas skabs gzhan du'ang rung*/ gong du bshams pa'i bum pa bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis kyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul pa bcings pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam rgyal bum par sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po

sogs nas/ steng nas steng du brtsegs pa// 'dab ma brgyad la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du shar du tshangs pa ser po zhes sogs nas thag bzangs ris dud ka rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan zhes dang*/ bum pa bcu yod na pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bcu'i steng du zhes sogs dang*/ rnam rgyal bum pa pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa sogs dang*/ phyogs mtshams kyi bum pa brgyad kyi nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan re re'i steng du shar du tshangs pa ser po// zhes sogs 'dra/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo skar ma'i phreng ba lta bu'i a ā/ zhes sogs sgrub thabs bzhin las/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa (194)chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhes sogs nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te/ zhes sogs 'dra ba las/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pas thig le cha dgur gyur/ de rnams gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ hūm̐ rnams su gyur/ de rnams lha mo brgyad bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang bcas pa rnams su gyur nas yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir 'thon te gdan so so'i steng du 'khod pa ni/ shar du go rī nag mo g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis lha mo rnams dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum par bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/

zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pa'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes sogs nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyai rdo rje lha dgu bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang bcas pa'i rnam par rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ mchod pa dang*/ dgug gzhug bya ba dang*/ dbang lha spyan drangs te mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas 'debs pa rnams gong bzhin las/ ḍom+bi nī la 'od dpag med/ ces pa'i rjes su/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ de nas oṃ bha ga wān zhes (195) sogs re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dang*/ hūm̐ am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ hūm̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kye rdo rje lha dgu bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang bcas pa'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes pas nang mchod phul/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi mthar/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing*/ zhes sogs kyis bstod la/ pad skor byas nas gzung thag blangs te/ bdag gi snying ga na sa sngags kyi phreng ba dmar po gzungs thag la brten te song bas bum nang gi lha rnams la phog pas lha rnams dmar lam song ste bdag gi dbang du 'dus shing ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ yab yum gyi snying po gnyis dang*/ 'khor gyi sngags thung rnams dang*/ las bum la 'khyil ba'i sngags rnams brgya rtsa re bzla/ slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka

zhes sogs yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod de/ gzungs thag bsdus la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal la// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ ces pa'i mthar pad skor sngon du 'gro bas dung chos blangs nas bum pa rnams su chu thig re blugs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i mthar/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas gtor ma rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zhes pa nas ha ho hrīḥ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod la/ mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad du (196)hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las shar du brgya byin zhes sogs dang*/ dbang ldan gyi dur khrod kyi steng gi char chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po zhes sogs dang*/ srin po'i dur khrod kyi 'og gi char chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu zhes sogs nas thugs rdo rje ma/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rnam par rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ dgug gzhug bya/ dbang lha spyan drangs te mchod cing gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba rnams gtor chog ltar byas la/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsams la/ mchod gtor 'bul ba nas mchod bstod phrin las bcol ba'i bar gtor chog ltar bya/

sgos kyi chos skyong rnams kyi gtor ma dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor logs nas 'byung ba ltar phul la rdo rje'i glu bkra shis bsngo ba smon lam gyi bar du bya'o// slob ma sta gon ni/ lus kyi bya ba nges 'byung bskyed// nang dbang bskur la khyad don zhu// spro ba bskyed de rgyun bshags bya// bsrung ba byas te mchod pas mchod// so shing dor la khyor chu blud// srung skud btags te ku sha sbyin// zab mo'i chos bshad rmi lam brtag /ces pa ltar ro// rjes chog ni/ mchod pa rnams bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs la/ re re'i mgor oṃ bha ga wān zhes sogs sbyar ba'i chu bzhi nyer spyod rol chen dang bcas pa dang*// nang mchod phul la hūm̐ am̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ oṃ āḥhūm̐ kye rdo rje lha dgu'i zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// zhes dang*/ rol chen dang bcas (197)te/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang*/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs bya/ 'og tu phyi nang yid byung bstod pa rnams bya zhes 'byung ba rnams su 'di bzhin shes par bya'o// de nas thal mo sbyar te he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzla/ ma 'byor ba dang nyams pa dang*/ zhes sogs kyi mthar khu tshur gnyis kyi mthe'u chung sbrel/ mdzub mo brkyangs te rtse sprad pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ oṃ badz+ra ut+tiṣ+ṭha sta gon gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad pa spyan drangs kyi bar du mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod la slar yang phyi nang yid byung bstod pa rnams byas te/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ chos skyong gi bris sku sogs gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la thal mo sbyar te/

phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gtor/ sku gzugs kyi rten med na de rnams mi dgos so// de nas rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod// (198)rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra muḥ zhes dang mtheb srin gyis se gol byas la ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dang*/ mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs gsal btab la mchod gtor dman mar rnams bsdus te/ las thig gi cha dbye ba dang thig tshon byin rlabs mi dgos na spyod lam la 'jug pa'i nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bya/ rdul tshon gyi phyogs ltar na 'og nas 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor bri zhing rgyan dgram pa yan chad grub nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis nyal la sang nangs par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs te/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā swa bhā ba shud+dho ྅ haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharma badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod cing dag pa rnam pa gsum dran par bya'o// lnga pa bri zhing rgyan dgram pa ni lag len bzhin du las thig btab la/

dkyil 'khor gyi dbus sam ji ltar rigs pa'i gzhir dbus su tshon sngon po la rdo rje'i rtses hūm̐ bri/ de bzhin du shar du dkar po la bh+rum̐/ lhor ser po la ām̐/ nub tu dmar po la dz+riṃ/ byang du ljang khu la kham̐ bri/ tshon so so'i steng kha dog dang mthun pa'i thig skud rnams kyang bzhag /mdun du mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma gcig bshams la rang kye rdo rje'i nga rgyal gyis thig tshon bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pām̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lnga'i steng du thig tshon sngon po hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ g.yas brgyad rdo rje g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum ma mā ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin (199)pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba// de bzhin du dkar po bh+rūm̐ las rnam snang dkar po g.yas brgyad 'khor lo g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo phyag mtshan kun la 'dra/ ser po ā+oṃ las rin 'byung ser po g.yas brgyad rin po che g.yon 'dra/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo/ dmar po dz+rāṃ las 'od dpag med dmar po g.yas brgyad pad+ma g.yon 'dra/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ kham̐ las don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas brgyad ral gri g.yon 'dra/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu phyag mtshan 'dra/ bsdu na rigs lnga zhal gcig phyag gnyis par bskyed kyang rung*/ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ// mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ rang gi mig g.yas pa ma las nyi ma/ g.yon pa ṭa las zla ba mig 'bras gnyis hūm̐ yig 'bar bar gyur par bsam la/ mig gi rdzi ma gyen thur du brdeb cing*/ sta gon gyi lha dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi thig tshon rigs lnga'i rnam pas byon te/ dam tshig pa la gnyis su med par thim/ nam mkha'i lha rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/

sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs lnga so sos dbu brgyan par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs kyis bstod/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang a kā ros phul te/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūm̐ nyer gcig bzlas/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis tshon rnams la reg cing yi ge rnams bsubs la/ lha rnams(200)'od du zhu ste de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdul phra rab las grub pa'i thig tshon du gyur zhes brjod/ thig skud rnams slob dpon gyi lag par blangs te/ go rī'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i slob ma la thig skud sngo dkar ser dmar ljang gu'i rim pas thig sna gtad de brkyangs la/ phan tshun rjes su rtogs pa ste// chos kun phan tshun rjes su rtogs// chos rnams thams cad shin tu yang*// kun tu 'gro bar chos kun brjod// ces brjod cing dang po so so dang de nas lhan cig tu bsgril bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gnyis su med par gyur par bsams la/ rdo rje la dkris te mtheb srin gyi bdud rtsi gtor la bzhag go /de nas slob dpon langs la dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar du bltas te/ thig skud dkris pa'i rdo rje rang gi lte ba'i thad du bzung la/ shar nas nub tu phyogs pa'i slob ma la dz+dzaḥganyis brjod cing thig sna gtad/ des kyang dz+dzaḥganyis brjod cing blangs te lte ba'i thad du bzung*/ slob dpon gyis oṃ badz+ra sū tram̐ sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs// 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pas// khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar// thig skud sgras ni skul ma 'debs// zhes brjod cing*/ dang por steng nas 'og tu gcus te nam mkha' la gyen du gdab/ de nas sa la phab ste thig chen brgyad po'i steng du btab pas dkyil 'khor du lam gyis byung bar bsam/

de'i tshe thig skud kyi sgras sangs rgyas thams cad bskul te nam mkha'i khams su byon nas byin gyis brlab par bsam la gdab bo// 'debs pa'i go rims ni/ nub shar byang lho me dbang ldan// rlung srin rlung dbang me srin po// g.yas skor (201)rgyab 'gros tshangs logs gdab// me rlung srin dbang g.yas skong du// rgyab 'gros spangs te zur thig gdab// nub shar gnas pas thig skud bsdu// gnyis sdebs dang po slob dpon dang*// phyi ma slob mar shes par bya// zhes so// de nas gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ oṃ badz+ra be gā kra ma hoḥ zhes brjod pas ye thig nam mkhar btegs nas slob dpon nang du zhugs te/ gzhi bca' pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje snying ga dang*/ dril bu dkur brten te/ hrīḥhrīḥzhes brjod cing khro bo'i lta bas sgo bzhi la shar nas g.yas skor du bltas pas sgo rnams bye bar bsam/ sgo bzhi'i thad kyi rtsa thig rnams dri bzang gi chus phyis la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad dbye bar bgyi'o zhes brjod/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su shar du phyogs pas 'dug la// chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni sgrol bar byed// kye yi rdo rje rgyal po che'i// dkyil 'khor snying po bri bar bya// oṃ badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya mā ti kra ma hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po ljang gu dmar po ser po dkar po'i rim pas sgo tshad gcig tsam bris la thod pa la sogs pas kha bcad nas steng du rdo rje gcig bzhag ste mchod pa lngas mchod/ dbus kyi phur khung 'og nas dkar po la sogs pa'i rim pas bkang la slob ma la sogs pas dbus nas rim pas bri/ rtsig pa sbrel ran pa nas thod pa bsal te sbrel/ mtshan ma brtags la ngan na nam mkha'i lha la mchod gtor phul te 'khyil bas bsrung ngo*// tshon gyi kha dog ni/

dbus kyi nyi ma dmar po la// pad lte sngon po ze'u 'bru ljang*/ (202)pad 'dab lha mo'i mdog can nam// phyogs mdog mdzes tshon gang rung bya// gdung zlum nag po rdo rje ser// lha snam phyogs mdog bum pas brgyan// gtso bo'i gnas su thod pa ni// sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa dang*// gri gug nag po gdan bcas bri// lha mo'i gnas su rang rang gi// g.yas kyi phyag mtshan gdan bcas bri// 'dod yon dmar po pha gu ser// drwa ba'i gzhi sngo drwa ba dkar// mda' yab khra bo phyi thig sngo// mun pa glang rgyab gnyis ka nas// ka ba ka rgyan rwa phyogs mdog /rta babs dmar sngo ljang ser rim// pad+ma chos 'khor gdugs ci mdzes// nyi dkyil ljang gu pad+ma yi// 'dab ma sna tshogs phyi dmar skya// dur khrod gzhi nag mtshan ma rnams// so so'i mdog can ci nus pa// rdo ra nag po rdo rje dkar// me ri sna tshogs su bri'o// bri ba rdzogs nas tshon gyi lhag /ye thig srad bur bcas bsdus la// mchod pa lngas mchod oṃ āḥhūm̐// badz+ra muḥyis ye shes pa// gshegs shing sprul pa rang la bsdu// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi nye logs kun 'byung dang dri bzang pos byugs la mchod pa ci 'byor ba bsham/ spos dang rol mo dang bcas te slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pas rnam rgyal dang*/ slob ma rnams kyis bum pa lhag ma rnams rim pas bzung nas dkyil 'khor la bskor ba bya ste/ slob dpon gyis lha so so'i sngags kyi mthar bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing lha so so'i gnas su de dang de'i bum pa lan re phul la/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su bum gdan gyi steng du bzhag /bum pa gnyis las (203)med na rnam rgyal lha grangs bzhin bskyar te phul la mthar shar ngos su bzhag /las bum 'bul ba'i tshe 'khyil pa bzlas la bdag dang dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyi bar chad thams cad srung du gsol zhes brjod de phyi'i byang shar la nye bar bzhag go

/dngos gzhi'i nyin par dkyil 'khor la// spyi dang so so'i mchod pa rnams// rdul tshon ltar na zlum po dang*// ras bris ltar na gru bzhir bsham// 'das dang 'jig rten sngon 'gro dang*// phyi rol gtor ma mchod sogs bcas// slob ma dbang bskur byed dgos na// de la dgos pa'i maṇ+ḍal dang*// mig ras me tog gu gul til// rigs drug mchod pa dbu rgyan dang*// rdor dril mig thur me long dang*// 'bud dung 'khor lo pu sti dang*// mda' gzhu snam sbyar bdud rtsi sogs// nyer mkho thams cad tshogs bya'o// drug pa sgrub cing mchod pa ni phyi 'phrad dam ji ltar 'os pa'i dus su slob dpon stan la 'dug /sngon 'gro rnam gsum nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i rjes kyi gsol gdab kyi bar sta gon gyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin byas la/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshe rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ lha mo brgyad zhal brgyad la thim zhes brjod/ de nas mdun bskyed bsgrub pa ni// bris la bdag nyid bsres byas la// mngal 'byin sta gon dam ye bsre// de la ye shes spyan drangs pas// rten la drug dang 'khor la lnga// gtso bo drug bsres bsdus pa'i lugs// zhes te rten gyi bskyed chog mi dgos par bris pa tsam la/ bdag (204)mdun 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bsres la mngal 'byin man chad 'dra bar byas na bsdus par 'gyur ro// bras dang bskyed dang bdag nyid bsra// mngal 'byin sta gon dam ye dang*// ye shes bsres pas lha 'dra yang*// rten la bdun bsres 'byung phyir rgyas// zhes te de'i sgrub tshul ni/ bris pa'i dkyil 'khor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje zhes sogs kyis thun mong ba'i srung 'khor bskyed pa nas/

thags zangs ris dud ka rnams 'gyel zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan zhes pa'i bar gong sta gon gyi skabs ltar byas la/ de nas bdag gis bsgoms pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo dang mdun bskyed kyi srung ba'i 'khor lo gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dur khrod brgyad dang mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag gis bsgoms pa'i gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa dang mdun bskyed kyi gzhal yas khang gdan dang bcas pa gnyis su med par gyur/ rang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te zhes sogs sgrub thabs bzhin las yum gyi mkhar bab pas thig le cha gnyis su gyur/ cha gcig yongs su gyur pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad srung ba'i 'khor lo dang bcas par gyur/ cha gcig cha dgur gyur pa gdan so so'i steng du (205)rim pa bzhin du 'khod pa ni/ dbus kyi thig le bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje zhes pa nas gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar dang*/ shar gyi thig le gau rī nag mo zhes sogs dang*/ lho'i thig le tsau rī/ nub kyi thig le be tā lī/ byang gi thig le ghasma ri/ byang shar gyi thig le puk+ka si/ shar lho'i thig le ri khrod ma/ lho nub kyi thig le gdol pa mo// nub byang gi thig le g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa zhes sogs nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal btab pa'am mi nus na lha rnams kyi ming brjod pa tsam bya'o// de nas mkha' nang gi gtso bo yab yum dpag tu med pa spros/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab/ sems can thams cad kyi zhe sdang dang rnam par shes pa'i phung po sbyangs/

chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus rang la thim pa ni rang nyid bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhes pa rnams gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o//

zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de bzhin du mkha' nang gi gau rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi gti mug dang gzugs kyi phung po sbyangs/ me long lta bu'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar du tshangs pa'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ gau rī nag mo g.yas gri gug /g.yon nya ro hi ta 'dzin pa/ mkha' nang gi tsau rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi nga rgyal dang ser sna dang tshor ba'i phung po sbyangs/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus lhor dbang po'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ tsau rī dmar (206)mo zhes sogs zhal phyag kun la gsal btab/ mkha' nang gi be ta lī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang 'du shes kyi phung po sbyangs/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub tu nyer dbang gi gdan la 'khod pa ni be tā li ser mo sogs dang*/ mkha' nang gi ghasma rī dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi phrag dog dang 'du byed kyi phung po sbyangs/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang du drag po'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ ghasma rī ljang gu sogs dang*/ mkha' nang gi puk+ka si dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi sa'i khams sbyangs/ byams pa tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus byang shar du gshin rje'i gdan la 'khod pa ni/ puk+ka sī sngon mo zhes sogs dang*/ mkha' nang gi ri khrod ma dpag tu med pa spros// sems can thams cad kyi chu'i khams sbyangs/ snying rje tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus shar lhor nor bdag gi gdan la 'khod pa ni ri khrod ma dkar mo zhes sogs dang*/ mkha' nang gi gdol pa mo dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi me'i khams sbyangs/ dga' ba tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus lho nub tu srin po'i gdan la 'khod pa ni gdol pa mo sngon mo zhes sogs dang*/ mkha' nang gi g.yung mo dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi rlung gi khams sbyangs/

btang snyoms tshad med pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus nub byang du thags bzang ris kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni g.yung mo kha dog sna tshogs pa zhes pa nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na (207)bzhugs pa'o zhes pa'i bar dang*/ mkha' nang gi gzhal yas khang dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi ma dag pa snod kyi 'jig rten sbyangs/ dag pa byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun rtogs pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus mdun bskyed kyi gzhal yas khang la thim/ mkha' nang gi dur khrod brgyad dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi rnam rtog sbyangs/ sgyu ma la sogs pa'i dpe brgyad rtogs pa la bkod/ tshur 'dus mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad la thim/ mkha' nang gi srung ba'i 'khor lo dpag tu med pa spros/ sems can thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus mdun bskyed kyi srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ zhes brjod de rkang thon du spro ba'o// byung rdzogs su spro na mngal du dkyil 'khor bskyed nas/ mkha' nang gi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa yum gyi bha ga nas phyir spros/ nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas tshur 'dus mdun bskyed kyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo// yang na gzhan rnams gong bzhin las/ rang nyid shar gyi sgo khang du/ gtso bo yab yum rnal 'byor gyis// gnas pas mngal 'byin byas kyang rung*// de tshe gtso bo lnga bsres 'gyur// zhes te cho ga gong 'og gzhan thams cad 'dra ba las/ bdag mdun bsre ba'i tshe rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su (208)phyin pa'i dmigs pa dor nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo khang du gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i mkha' gsang byin rlabs man gong du bshad pa bzhin byas la gtso bo mngal 'byin byas pa'i rjes su tshur 'dus dbus su gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa ni/

zhes sogs kyis gsal gdab/ 'og tu rang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las he ru kar bye ba'i dmigs pa dor la shar sgor gnas bzhin pa de nyid kyis mchod pa 'bul ba sogs la 'jug pa ni lugs gcig ste las kyi slob mas sgrub mchod byed na 'di ltar byas pa bde'o// de nas lha de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes sogs nas thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma zhes pa'i bar du brjod la/ dngos gzhi dang po'i tshe lag pas rdo rje gsor zhing*/ snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis sta gon gyi lha'i phyi 'brang gi bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsams la/ ngag tu āṣ+ṭā bzla/ sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān zhes sogs lan cig sngon du 'gro ba'i/ oṃ nī ri zhes sogs chu bzhi tsam phul la/ gau rī la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas dgug gzhug bya ste/ 'di dngos gzhi gnyis pa man chad la mi dgos so// de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs gong ltar chu bzhis mchod la/ go rī la sogs pas dgug gzhug bya'o// slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs pa de la mchod pa/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa rnams lha sta (209)gon bzhin bya/ de nas lha rnams la dmigs la/ hūm̐ shrī he badz+ra oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes sogs yig brgya ci rigs bzla/ de bzhin du/ nam̐ nai rāt+ma oṃ shrī badz+ra zhes sogs dang*/ gam̐ gau rī am̐ shrī badz+ra= bam̐ bai tā li oṃ shrī badz+ra= gham̐ ghasma rī oṃ shrī badz+ra= pam̐ puk+ka sī oṃ shrī badz+ra= sham̐ sha wa rī oṃ shrī badz+ra= lam̐ tsaṇ+ḍa lī oṃ shrī badz+ra= ḍam̐ ḍam+bi nī oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka zhes sogs ci rigs bzlas pa'i rjes su rdo rje thal mo sbyar la/

rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes pa'i mthar rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo thugs ka nas he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas bye ste/ shar phyogs kyi sgo khang du 'khod par gyur zhes brjod/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsams te/ chu bzhi nyer spyod gos zur nang mchod yid byung bstod thung bstod ring rnams sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin byas la rang gi lce bdud rtsi myangs te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas snying ga'i hūm̐ lha thams cad kyi ngo bo mnyes par bsam te 'di ma chad pa gal che'o// de nas sgrub grogs gcig āṣ+ṭā bzla zhing dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug la/ rang nyid grogs dang bcas pas sgrub khang gi phyi'am/ dkyil 'khor dang yol bas bar du chod pa'i sar phyin la/ ji ltar 'os pa'i stegs la gtor ma gcig dang*/ de'i g.yas su chu bzhi dang*/ g.yon du nyer spyod lnga mdun nas rgyab tu sgreng tshar du bshams/ mdun du nang mchod kyang bshams la/ gtor ma chab kyis bran te rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pas gtor ma nang (210)mchod ltar byin gyis brlab la/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum sum brtsegs kyi nang du pam̐ pam̐ pam̐ las pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa re re/ steng gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje sogs dang*/ bar gyi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su thugs rdo rje/ shar du brgya byin sogs dang*/ 'og gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur ba las dbus su gsung rdo rje zhes sogs nas dbang bskur ba'i bar sngar dang 'dra ba las/

sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ thugs rdo rje phyogs skyong brgyad dang bcas pa la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan zhes pa'i mthar/ oṃ nī ri zhes sogs kyis chu bzhi dang*/ oṃ in+ta dza ma zhes sogs kyis gtor ma phul la/ mchod pa nas bar chad thams cad srung ba dang stong grogs mdzod cig /ces pa'i bar sngon 'gro'i gtor ma'i skabs bzhin brjod/ de nas dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ rdo rje'i glu bkra shis smon lam rnams bya/ de'i tshe sgrub grogs kyis zhal zas nas brtsams te 'thor 'thung gi bar gyi mchod pa rnams g.yas skor gyi rim pas gtor snod du bsdu la/ slob dpon gyis mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi ka wān a pa na ya hūm̐ zhes brjod/ de'i tshe slob mas mchod yon gyi chu gtor snod la bskor te lhag ma gtor ma 'gro phyogs (211)su bsgreng la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hṛ da yam+me a dhi tiṣ+ṭha/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca/ badz+rī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes gur nas 'byung ba'i yi ge brgya pa'i mthar muḥzhes dang lag pa g.yas sa la reg pas gtor mgron sgrub khang gi phyogs mtshams rnams su gshegs par bsams shing*/ sgrub mchod rjes ma'i nyin ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod/ gang ltar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas rang dang sgrub grogs kyi gnas gsum bsrungs la/ gtor ma rol mo dang bcas pas gtsang sar bskyal te/

āṣ+ṭā bzla zhing rol mo rgyun chags dang bcas pas slob dpon gyis rting mnan nas nang du log ste yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing shong na dngos su dkyil 'khor la bskor ba gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bya/ mi shong na 'dod snam gyi steng nas byas par bsams la/ mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang*/ bying ba dang rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa dang cho ga lhag chad du gyur pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa la sogs pa dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub ba la skyon du gyur pa gang lags pa de dag thams cad bzod par mdzad de lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol zhes brjod cing*/ (212)rdor dril 'dzin bzhin pas phyag byas nas gral la 'dug go /gal te rab gnas rten yod na// skabs 'dir rab gnas sta gon bya// phyi dro'i dus su bdag 'jug blang*// sang nyin snga bar dkyil 'khor gyi// sgrub mchod byas te rab gnas dang*// grub na rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya// phyi ma red dus su bdag 'jug dang*// slob ma dbang bskur sogs bya'o// rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs med na// skabs 'di nyid du bdag 'jug dang*// slob ma dbang bskur la sogs bya// dngos gzhi gnyis pa man chad nas// skabs 'dir bum bskyed sngar bzhin du// byas te bdag 'jug sogs bya'o// bdun pa 'jug cing dbang blang ba la thog mar bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes brjod/ las bum gyi chus kha bshal la/ mdun bskyod kyi gtso bo de rang gi rtsa ba'i bla mar mos te/ bla mas mdzad dgos pa rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang*/

dbang rdzas 'grim pa rnams de'i thugs ka nas byai ba'i he ru ka zhig gis mdzad par bsams shing dngos su thams cad rang nyid kyis byas la/ dkyil 'khor 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdag med ma yis mgrin 'khyud pa'i// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum (213)bdag kyang bdag la stsal// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum brjod/ sdom pa bsgrag pa bdag 'jug gi skabs su mdzad pa'i phyag len yang snang bas de bzhin byed par spro na/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// blo chen khyod kyis gzung bya ste// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes su bshad// slob dpon khyod kyis gzung bar bya// bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa dam tshig yin par bzung*// rin chen rigs mchog chen po la// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam chos khyod kyis gzung bar bya// 'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par gsungs// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus byos// de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni// phas pham par ni rab tu bshad// spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste// rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya// gal te nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa// kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur// khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya// (214)ma byin par yang mi blang ngo*// 'dod la log par mi spyad cing*// brdzun du smra bar mi bya'o// phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi// chang ni rnam par spang byar bya// sems can don phyir ma gtogs pa// bya ba ma yin thams cad spang*// dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing*// rnal 'byor pa kun bsnyen bskur bya// lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang*// ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*// yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni// ci nus par ni rjes su bskyang*// theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya// sems can don la rgyab phyogs min// 'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang*// rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya zhing*// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*// mtshan ma 'gom par mi bya'o// 'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad// khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya// rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni// gsang ba'i rgyud las rab tu bshad// ces lan gcig bsgrag

/'di bdag 'jug gi tshe ma byas kyang rung ngo*// de nas// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// zhes sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*// sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes sogs rigs lnga'i sdom gzung lan gsum byas la/ ā khaṃ wi ra hūm̐ zhes pas

mig ras 'ching tshul bya/ sngags de nyid kyis me tog gi phreng ba blangs/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par bsams la/ a mṛ ta bzla zhing las bum gyi chus gtor/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga' zhes dang*/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o// zhes pas dris lan dang po dang*/ (215)de yis su la ci zhig bya zhes dang*// sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go / zhes dris lan gnyis pa byas par bsams la/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas par gyur// oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa da ya mī/ zhes dang*/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ho// sid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khāṃ zhes brjod/ gsang bar gdams pa ni rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su rab tu zhugs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes brjod/ hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ zhes pa'am dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho// zhes pas gtso bo'i drung du bzhag par bsams la dkyil 'khor la mgo dud tsam bya/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni rdo rje spyi bo dang*/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya'i/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re zhes brjod/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni rdo rje snying ga dang*/

he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes dang*/ slar yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag ste/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na (216)'dis khyod kyi mgo bo 'gems par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod/ gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni rnam rgyal gyi chu dung chos su blugs pa'am/ bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir nang mchod nas myang la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na bsreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ pañca a mṛ ta ud ka ṭha ṭha ṭha/ zhes brjod/ bla ma'i bka' gnyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni rdo rje spyi bo dang*/ /deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de khyed kyis bya dgos so// nga la yang brnyas pa ma byed cig /byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung bar 'gyur ta re zhes pas dam la bzhag /maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab ces sogs nas ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o// zhes sogs brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ rang nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu gdungs pa lta bu chang zung thur du bstan/ mchog ma gnyis gyen du bstan pa la g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du rkang pa gnyis bgrad nas gnas pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzheṃ ljang gu drag cing bzod par dka' ba rkang pa'i bar du raṃ las byung ba'i me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa// snying gar laṃ las byung ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa'i lte ba la hūm̐/

mgrin par paṃ las byung ba'i chu'i (217)dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa la as mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaṃ las byung ba'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa lta bu has mtshan pa/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa/ rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos te sum mdo'i me sbar/ rkang mthil gyi dzhīṃ mer 'bar ba long bu gnyis nas zhugs sum mdo'i gnas su 'dzom ste drag tu 'bar bas snying ga'i sa bsros/ mgrin pa'i chu bskol ba'i zeg ma snying ga'i sa'i steng du bab/ de nas rkang 'og gi rlung gis gyen la bteg /spyi bo'i rlung gis thur la mnan te bar snang du yed yed yod par bsams/ de'i tshe gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kha ba chen po bab pa bzhin du rang gi ba spu'i bu ga rnams la sib sib thim par bsams la/ gtso bos mdzad par bsams shing rdo rje dril bu dkrol te/ hūm̐ a ha dzhaiṃ zhes dang*/ a we sha ya stam̐ bha ya stam̐ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūm̐ a ha dzhā+eṃ zhes mang du brjod/ bdag 'jug gi tshe rdzas kyi dud pa dang*/ spog chog mi mdzad/ brtan pa'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag ste tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod/ dril bu bcad gtub tu dkrol la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha ye rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog / ces lan gsum brjod/ nam mkha'i kha dog brtags (218) dkar ser dmar nag ljang gu'am sna tshogs rnams mthong na/ zhi rgyas dbang drag sna tshogs rnams 'grub po snyam du dran par byas/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol zhing*/

zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces sogs kyis bstod de/ gtso bo'i dbu la me tog phul bar bsams la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ/ zhes brjod cing dbul/ he ru ka des/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+waṃ i mam̐ sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog phog pa'i lha la zhus pas lha des me tog rang gi spyi bor bzhag par bsam te/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye ba thams cad mthong 'gyur ba// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ zhes pas mig ras bkrol bar bsams la/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// me tog gang du lhung gyur pa// de ni khyed kyi he ru ka /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// nga ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis// zhes dang*/ lha ngo sprad pa yang blangs te dkyil 'khor bstan pas ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mthong bar mos la/ bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas par bsam te// oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so// oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong*// oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur// sa ma ya hoḥhoḥhoḥ zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab ces sogs nas/ rdo rje (219)slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o zhes sogs dang*/ byang chub rdo rje sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis mdzes pa 'dod snams pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab pu shu la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seng ges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du rang nyid bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa yum rdo rje bdag med ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur zhes pa tsam mam/

spro na zhal phyag rdzogs par gsal btab/ de'i g.yas g.yon du sbyar ba'i yo byad rnams dang*/ steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun du dung dang*/ 'phen dang*/ me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ nī ri zhes sogs gsum dang*/ oṃ ār+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūm̐ zhes chu bzhis sbyangs la/ /bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sdig pa'i sa bon kam̐ yig gi rnam pas sna sgor thon nas mdun til la thim pa/ he ru kas mer bsregs shing chur dor bar bsams pa'am/ yang na yungs kar gyis sbyangs par bsams la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya/ badz+ra sa twa s+ya/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā/ zhes brjod cing g.yas pas g.yas dang*/ g.yon pas g.yon dang*/ gnyis kas g.yas su bskor la me dang chur dor bar bsam/ de bzhin du/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa ces brjod la bskor zhing byams te gnyis ka'ang lan gsum gsum byas nas me chur bcug ste dor bar bsam la/ bdag gi byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad nye bar (220) zhi bar gyur cig / ces brjod/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams kyis bdag la bkra shis par bsams la/ dril bu bsil zhing me tog gtor/ sgrub grogs kyis rnam rgyal bum pa btegs te/ phun sum tshogs pa la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad gsum mam/ spro na mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bkra shis kyang bya bar gsungs pas bogs nas 'byung ba ltar byas la/ mthar bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spang bya mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig ces brjod/ dbang dngos la gnyis/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs dang*/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/

de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa kye rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rdo rje/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes pa nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mi bskyod pa kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ ba hoḥ zhes pa lan gnyis sam/ spro na so so'i sngags rgyas bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/ (221)yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug /khro bo bcu dang bcas pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa zhes sogs gsungs shing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bas/

dbang gi chu rgyun des smin mtshams yan chad gang bum pa'i dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang gsang ba'i dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang mchog tu bde ba chen po bzhi pa'i dbang thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de la/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa nas nai wī d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar gyis mchod/ de ltar (222)na mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang bskur ba thob ces pa nas mi bskyod pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag / ces pa'i bar lam dus bzhin brjod/ dbang lha spyan drangs pa dang mi bskyod pa'i khyad chos rnams dor ba ma gtogs 'og ma rnams la'ang 'di'i rigs 'gres sbyar te shes par bya'o// swa bhā wa/ bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du āṃ las rin po che āṃ gis mtshan pa// de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang rin chen 'byung ldan kye rdo rje sku mdog ser po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad rin po che/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i ām̐ḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par gong ltar spyan drangs te so so la bstim/ 'di yan chad la cho ga zor yang ba'i phyir dbang lha spyan 'dren gong gi de nyid las mi mdzad pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab la/ badz+rī bha wa sogs kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag

/chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum snyoms par zhugs zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni zhes sogs(223)kyi mthar/ rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra rat+na mu ku ṭa/ zhes sogs kyis dbu rgyan bcings te dbang bskur bar bsam/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa zhes sogs gsungs shing bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ de ltar na rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sgo nas cod pan gyi dbang thob/ zhes pa nas rin chen 'byung ldan gyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag

ces pa'i bar brjod/ swa bhā wa= bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du dzhīṃ:las pad+ma dz+riṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka 'od dpag med kye rdo rje sku mdog dmar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad pad+ma/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu gti mug ces sogs nas/ thugs ka'i dz+riṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs la bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs 'dra/ badz+rī bha wa sogs kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi 'od dpag med yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// zhes sogs nas khyod kyis longs/ oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐// (224) zhes pas lag pa g.yas su rdo rje byin par bsam/ badz+rī bha wa zhes sogs kyis chu'i dbang bskur 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ de ltar na 'od dpag med kyi sgo nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ ces sogs nas/ 'od dpag med kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag / ces pa'i bar brjod/ swa bhā wa/ bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa// de las 'od zer 'phros yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang don yod grub pa kye rdo rje sku mdog ljang gu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/

zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad ral gri/ g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu/ zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i kham̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don yod grub pa kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te so so la bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs 'dra/ badz+rī bha was dbang rdzas kyi lha'i spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi don yod grub pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ/ zhes sogs kyis dril bu lag pa g.yon du byin par bsams te/ badz+rī bha wa sogs kyis chu'i dbang bskur/ don yod grub pas dbur rgyan puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ de ltar na don yod grub pa'i sgo nas dril bu'i dbang thob/ ces sogs nas/ (225)don yod pa'i grub pa'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag / ces pa'i bar brjod/ swa bhā wa/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rnam par snang mdzad kye rdo rje sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad 'khor lo// g.yon brgyad des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i bh+rūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kye rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te bstim/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa staṃ/ zhes sogs kyi mthar rang gi gsang mtshan nas brjod de/ che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes brjod cing rdo rje dril bu lhan cig spyi bor dkrol/ chu'i dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod/ de ltar na rnam par snang mdzad kyi sgo nas ming gi dbang thob/ ces pa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// zhes brjod/ rigs lnga po de dag gi phyag mtshan rnams rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba ltar gsal btab kyang rung ngo*// de nas/ dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ zhes sogs brjod de/ (226)chos can gyi snang ba gang dang gang snang ba thams cad tha mal pa ma yin par lhag pa'i lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin yin no// snyam du bsam mo// oṃ swa bhā wa/ bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag mtshan mi bskyod pa bzhin bskyed/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mig tu/ zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs te bstim/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ badz+rī bha wa sogs kyis

chu'i dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ de nas hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ zhes sogs sngags dang bcas pas lag pa g.yas su byin par bsam la/ gsol te snying gar bzung bas/ deng phyin chad tha mal pa'i spyod pa thul la/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin la zhugs par gyis shig / ces gsung bar bsam/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba/ zhes sogs lan gsum (227) gyis gsol ba btab/ rang nyid dbang stegs kyi steng du rdo rje 'chang chen po'i rnam pas 'khod par bsams la/ 'di de sogs sngags dang bcas pas g.yas su rdo rje byin pa snying gar gzung ste/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// zhes sogs brjod/ rdo rje 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rig stong dbyer med kyi ngo bo mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi sems thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i byang chub kyi sems spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba nges don gyi rdo rje yin no snyam du bsam/ de nas aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur pa/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi// zhes sogs kyis lag pa g.yon du byin pa dkrol te/ dku g.yon par kha gyen du phyogs pas bzung la/ aḥsrid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag / ces sogs brjod de/ dril bu 'di ni chos kyi dbyings spros pa thams cad dang bral ba skye 'gas gnas gsum gyis stong pa mtshon par byed pa yin la/ rang gi ngag srid pa thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ston par byed pa'i nges don gyi dril bu yin no snyam du bsam/ de nas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' bshad ma thag pa ltar ram/ phyag gnyis pa gang rung du bsgom nas yan lag bzhi rdzogs mi byed par/
