shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// zhes sogs rim bzhin brjod pa tsam mam phyag len la/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa/ lo grangs bcu drug lon pa lta bu dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ mig tu zhes sogs nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi rnam par rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs la bstim/ shes rab bcu drug sogs dang*/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zhes sogs brjod/ lag pa gnyis snying gar bsnol la/ srid pa'i (228)bde ba sogs brjod de/ tha mal pa'i bde ba ni ma dag pa'o// srid pa'i sdug bsngal zad par bya ba'i phyir rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnal 'byor bya ste 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la longs spyod cig /thams cad la mchod pa gyis shig /'dis rdo rje 'chang chen po kha sbyor gyi sku thob pa las mi 'da' 'o// de bas na ting nge 'dzin 'di la gnas par gyis shig / ces gsung bar bsams la de brtan pa'i ched du nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs dang*/ ye shes kyi chus gang ba'i bum pas dbang bskur bar bsams la/ rnam rgyal bum pa thogs te/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// zhes sogs nas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag / ces pa'i bar mi bskyod pa chu dbang gi skabs ltar brjod la/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ngo bo rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsam/ spros pa la dga' na gong gi sangs rgyas rnams ni zhes sogs kyi mthar bum pa so sos chu dbang rgyas par bskur la mthar rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab bo// gang ltar yang*/

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā zhes brjod cing me tog gtor te rab gnas byas la/ puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod de rdo rje dril bu dang dbu rgyan sogs bzhag la/ de ltar na khyod la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbang bskur ba 'dis khyod kyi phung po dang khams dang*/ skye mched kyi dri ma thams cad dag par byas pa yin pas de thams cad rang gi sems su 'du la sems de nyid mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje sems dpa' yin pas rang gi sems rnam par dag pa nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yin te// dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa// yid kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa nyid// gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni// sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs nyid// de yi phyi rol gru bzhi ni// mnyam pa nyid kyi rang bzhin no// gang zhig byams pa la sogs sems// thig skud bzhir ni bshad pa'o// rdo rje'i thig tu gang bshad pa// chos ni rjes su dran pa'o// lta ba kun las (229)rnam grol ba// ye shes thig tu bshad pa yin// rgyan gang yang dag bshad pa ni// tshul khrims sogs kyi sdom pa'o// dbang po lnga sogs sems gang yin// ra ba lngar ni 'byung ba nyid// gang zhig sgo zhes bshad pa ni// rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi// rta babs ka ba bzhi po ni// yang dag spong ba bzhi zhes brjod// dran pa nyer gzhag bzhi po ni// kha khyer bzhir ni brjod pa nyid// sgo khyud bzhi ni gang yin pa// rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam pa bzhi// de bzhin me tog phreng rgyan pa// byang chub yan lag bdun po yin// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni// ka ba brgyad po zhes brjod do// lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni// rnga yab tu ni rab tu grags// gang zhig do shal bshad pa ni// nyon mongs thams cad gcod pa ste// kun tu gcod pa'i ngo bo yin// nyon mongs 'phrog pas dran pa nyid// tshogs gnyis dag pa'i sbyor ba yis// 'khor lo bskor ba gang yin pa// nyon mongs phyed ni gcod pas na// do shal phyed pa nyid du brjod// de bas na sems nyid ni byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo gzhal yas khang pa yin la// sems la phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa du mar snang ba ni gdan gsum tshang ba'i lha yin te/

de yang phung po lnga ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan/ 'byung ba bzhi ni rig ma'i gdan/ nang gi skye mched ni byang chub sems dpa'i gdan/ phyi'i skye mched ni lha mo'i gdan// nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa la sogs pa zad par byed pa ni khro bo dang khro mo'i gdan yin no// zhes brjod/ bsdu na tshigs bcad rnams dor la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yin te zhes pa'i mjug tu/ sems nyid ni byang phyogs so bdun gyi ngo bo zhes pa man chad sbrel btsam byas kyang rung zhing*/ shin tu rgyas pa la spro na phung khams skye mched kyi dag pa rnams brjod do// rjes gnang bsdus dang cung zad rgyas/ /shin tu rgyas pa rnam pa gsum// zhes te bsdus pa ni/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma bsdu (230)ba nyid du gyis// zhes gsungs pas thabs sna tshogs kyis sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa tsam dang*/ cung zad rgyas par byed na de'i steng du 'og nas 'byung ba ltar rigs lnga'i sprul pa gang tsam bya'o// rgyas pa la gsum las/ lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ni/ gang skor sngon du 'gro nas rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dku g.yas g.yon du bzhag ste/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang bcas la rnam rol zhing*// rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis// dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyis// āḥ de bzhin du khu tshur gnyis kha 'gram g.yas g.yon du bzhag ste/ /sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang*// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya// des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur// phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no// oṃ khu tshur gnyis kha nas tshig 'byin pa ltar byas te/ /lus can kun la dam chos kyi// glu ni khyod kyis blangs par bya// de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni// myur tu bde ba myong bar 'gyur// gī rdo rje thal mo spyi bor bskor ba'i gar byas te/ /de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya// sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyis// gar mkhan tshul du sgyur bar gyis// hoḥ

khu tshur gnyis bdug spos kyi phyag rgya dang*/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas// brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis// lus can 'di gshegs cha lugs su// ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ hūm̐ me tog gi phyag rgya dang*/ /sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor// byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas// mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi// bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis// bh+rūm̐ mar me'i phyag rgya dang*/ /chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas// rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru// sems can ma rig ldongs pa la// ye shes sgron mes gsal bar gyis/ pra g.yon pas dung chos 'dzin cing g.yas pas dri bzang byug pa'i tshul dang*/ /rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*// rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi// byang chub lus can rnams la bsgom// gā zhes brjod/ sems can gyi don bya ba'i rjes gnang ni/ rtsa ba'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags

(231) pa'i bur ma'am/ med na rdo rjes mig 'byed pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// ling thog rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa lam̐ hrīḥpraṃ zhes brjod/ me long len pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes brjod/ āḥ las skyes pa'i dril bu blangs te/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas// kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal// zhes brjod cing dkrol/ /hoḥ zhes pas mda' gzhu byin nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig / ces gsung bar bsam la phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og gnyis su mda' 'phen tshul bya'o// me long rdo rje dang bcas pa len tshul bya'o/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso// gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems ni 'di yin par shes par gyis shig ces brjod// chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ/ zhes pas rkang pa'i 'og tu 'khor lo// oṃ badz+ra bha ṣa raṃ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su dung*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥ zhes pas g.yon du dril bu/ a zhes pas lag ngar gyi steng du pusti rnams byin par bsam la// deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// khyed kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu (232)gang bar gyis// sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis// skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*// khyed la rtag tu srung ba mdzad//

ces brjod/ gar skor sngon du 'gro bas rigs lnga so so'i phyag chen rnams rim bzhin bcas la// sems can kun la thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// zhes pa'i tshe rnam snang dang*/ de bzhin du tshig rkang dang po gsum 'dra ba las rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhes dang mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhes dang rin 'byung*/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhes dang 'od dpag med/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor zhes dang don grub kyi phyag rgya byas la/ de ltar na khyed kyis sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo// rdo rje'i 'khor lo// rin chen 'khor lo// pad+ma'i 'khor lo// sna tshogs 'khor lo rnams bskor la// sems can thams cad la chos kyi dung bus// sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis shig ces gnang ba byin par bsam/ de ltar na bskyed pa rdul tshon nam/ ras bris gang yin skabs dang sbyar la/ dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob gtso bor lus kyi dri ma dag /dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang bar byas/ brda lnga bsdus rtse mos mnan pa/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs kyis bstod// bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcings la/ bla ma he ru (233)ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs te/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bu'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i thig le mu tig gi rdog ma lta bu bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag par bsams shing dngos su bdud rtsi myangs la/

ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// zhes sogs brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes brjod cing myangs pas mgrin pa nas thig le 'phel te lus thams cad gang bas rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa thams cad 'gags te/ gsal stong gi ting nge 'dzin rgyud la skyes par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas bsrungs te mig ras phye bar bsam/ de nas bla ma shākya thub pa'i rnam par 'phos nas chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu dang g.yas pas rdor dril 'dzin pa'i skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgyas rang gi gsang mtshan nas lung ston par bsams la/ dngos su rang gis de ltar byas te// 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams su bhur+bhuwaḥswaḥ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no// zhes brjod/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag /dam tshig sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu bsten pa la dbang bar byas/ brda mtheb srin e la rig byed gcig /lam bdag byin gyis brlab pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no// (234) zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bstod pa dang gsol gdab gong ltar byas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcings/ bla mas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i phyag rgya ma zhig bdag la gtad par bsams te/ dga' ster gnas ster sogs brjod/ phyag rgya des/

bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// zhes pa nas/ bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam// zhes pa'i bar gyis dri ba byas par bsam/ bdag gis kyang bshang gci dag ni zhes pa nas/ bdag nyid ci dgar spro gyur to// zhes pa'i bar gyis lan btab pas phyag rgya de dges nas lus gcer bur phyung*/ chu skyes gur gum la sogs pas dri zhim par byas/ rtsa mchog tu rgyas pa'i pad+ma ston bzhin du// e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di// zhes sogs gyi rjes su staṃ pad+ma bhañja mok+ṣa hoḥ zhes gsungs shing rang gi pang du byon par bsam/ rang nyid kye rdo rje dang phyag rgya bdag med mar gsal ba lha'i 'du shes mkha' gsang byin rlabs sgrub thabs ltar dran pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan skyes mngon du bya'o snyam pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ rim pa bzhin sprul longs chos gsum lam du byed thabs 'du shes gsum dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas snyoms par zhugs pas/ yas bab dang mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i rtogs pa skyed par mos la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras phye bar bsam/ de nas lam gyi dbugs dbyung bsdus pa ni// byang chub sems ni spang mi bya// rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ste// gang zhig bskyed pa tsam gyis ni// sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur the tshom med// dam pa'i chos ni smad mi bya// nam yang dor bar yongs mi bya// mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis// de nyid brtan par mi bya'o// rdo rje dril bu mi spang ste// slob dpon nam yang smad mi bya// sangs rgyas kun dang mtshungs pa yi// rang bdag yongs su (235)spangs nas su// dka' thub kyis ni gdung mi bya// ji ltar bde bar bde bzur na// 'di ni ma 'ongs rdzogs sangs rgyas// zhes pa'am/ rgyas par na// slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing*// bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya// spun la smad pa nyid mi bya// sems can rnams la gdug byams dang*// byang chub sems ni spang mi bya// bdag gzhan chos la smad mi bya// skal med de nyid gtam mi bya// bdag gi lus la nges mi smad// chos la yid gnyis spang bya zhing*// gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya// chos nyid tshad ni gzung mi bya// skal ldan sems can spang mi bya// dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya// bud med nyid la smad mi bya// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya// rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya// rdo rje dril bu gzung bar bya// gtsug tor rtag tu bcang bar bya// rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya// rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya// rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya// 'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin// phyag rgya bcing ba rnams spang zhing*// mchod rten las ni mi bya ste// rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya// dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las// rmi lam du yang mi bya'o// slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya// bla ma'i rgan rabs phyag 'tshal lo// rtag par rgyun du sngags bzla zhing*// bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par spyad// rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing*// rtag pa ru ni bshad pa gyis// rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya// rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya// dzam+bha lha la chu sbyin zhing*// las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad// bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang*// mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya// zhes brjod de/

don yid la dran par bya'o// 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung ni// (236)'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o// ma hā sa ma ya hā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa ste de'i don ni dad pa chen pos lha dang bla ma la chags pa/ snying rje chen pos sems can gyi don la chags pa/ shes rab chen pos chos kyi de kho na nyid la chags pa zhes bya ba 'di gsum dang bral na sdig che ba yin pas 'di gsum dang ma bral ba la bslab par bya'o// de nas rang nyid kyis dkyil 'khor la brkyang phyag lan gsum byas pa'i tha mal dkyil 'khor pa rnams la lus phul bar bsams la// sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur ba'i// slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags// zhes phul bas de rnams kyis 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung bar bsams te/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur par// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs// sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas// dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris// khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su// sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya// khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// zhes brjod/ de ltar na phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag /dam tshig bud med la mi smod pa la dbang*/ brda byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ lam dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang 'bras bu chos sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la// mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ (237)gis mig ras bcing*/ ye shes 'di ni sogs brjod la// lus bsam gtan gyi chos dang ldan par byas/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor bzhag /sems dus gsum gyi rtog pa'i rgyu 'grul gzhan thams cad bcad la brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems su nges pa'i shes pa bskyed de/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug gsum dbyer mi phyed pa rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sku bzhi rang chas su gnas pa de nyid 'bras dus kyi sku bzhi dang ngo bo dbyer med du nges shes bskyed de/ de mngon du byed pa'i thabs gzhan gyis tshig tu brjod pa la sogs pas rtogs par mi nus pas/ dpe dbang gsum pa'i ye shes kyi steng du ngo sprad de rtogs par bya ba ni/ rang nyid dbang gsum pa'i gnas skabs su lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i sku can du snang ba sprul pa'i sku dang*/ de'i sems rgyud phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyar ba las byung ba'i bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi rnam par shar ba longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang*/ lha sku bde ba chen po'i rnam par snang tsam de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum thams cad dang bral ba chos kyi sku dang*// de gsum ldog tshul tha dad kyang rang bzhin so sor dbyer mi phyed pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku ste/ mdor na sems kyi gshis cir yang ma yin pa// gdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa/ rtsal sna tshogs su 'char ba/ bsgom bya sgom byed thams cad las 'das pa nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas la nam mkha' dang nam mkha' ro gcig pa ltar/ sems dang bde stong ro gcig pa'i ngang la 'dzin med du khong lhod kyis glod de mnyam par bzhag /mthar oṃ aḥhūm̐ gis mig ras phye la/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// btsud pa dang ni mthong ba (238)yis// de ring sdig las rnam grol 'gyur// de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyin chad 'chi ba yod ma yin// mi thub pa dang mi 'chi bas// cis kyang ma 'jigs dga' bar gyis// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/

/zhes brjod de/ don yid la dran pa'i sgo nas gzengs bstod do// de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum char gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag /dam tshig dgongs te gsungs pa'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang*/ brda mdzub mo nam mkha' mtshon pa/ lam rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku'i sa bon rgyud la bzhag pa yin no zhes rtogs pa bskyed la/ gnas skabs de dag tu thob pa'i dam tshig la bsrung sdom bgyid snyam pas// gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum dang*/ dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtong rag tu maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa phul te/ lus dang longs spyod thams cad kyang 'bul na cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum brjod// de nas dam tshig gsum gyi glu blang ba ni// gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*// gang gis dbang skur ba'i slob dpon dang*/ gang la bskur ba'i slob ma ste/ 'khor gsum ka snang la rang bzhin med pa skye med bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin las ma 'das pa de'i mthus bdag gis kyang de ltar rtogs par gyur cig snyam pas// tshigs bcad re re'i mtshams su rdo rje gsol/ dril bu bcad gtubs su bkrol te/ /oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// kye yi rdo rje bdag 'grub mdzod// kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod// (239)nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod// shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems su bdag sgrub mdzod// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog

/dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems bdag bdag sgrub mdzod// sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi yid la zhugs// sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid// 'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /ces lan gcig dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du snang ba yang chos sku stong pa dang snying rje gnyis su med pa las byung ba'i byin rlabs dang*/ slob dpon gyis kyang de ltar rtogs pa'i byin rlabs kyis// slob ma rnams kyis kyang mtshan ma tsam ma yin par snang la rang bzhin med par gzugs kyi skur mthong bar gyur cig snyam pas/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa// bden pa de yis mgon bdag la// khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /

ces bden stobs brjod do// skabs 'dir gtor ma rnams nang mchod chu chang gis bran la/ sngar sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar gyi cho gas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma rnams dbul ba'o/ /slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ni// lhag gnas byas pa'i slob ma rnams// khrus byas gral rim bzhin du dgod// (240)maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab// spom pa bsgrag gzung rim bzhin bya// gdong bcing me tog phreng ba gtad// 'khyil bas bsangs te dris lan bya// nang gi sems bskyed gsang bar gdams// dkyil 'khor nang bcug dam la bzhag /maṇ+ḍal phul te gsol ba gdab// ye shes dbab cing brtan par bya// gsol gdab kha dog dris la bstod// me tog dbul zhing mig ras dbye// dkyil 'khor bstan pa 'jug pa'o// dbang la yon 'bul gsol ba gdab// lhar bskyed byung bsal shis pa brjod// chu dang cod pan rdo rje dang*// dril bu ming dang brtul zhugs dang*// slob dpon dbang bskur rnam dag bstan// rjes gnang gsang dbang lung bstan bya// shes rab ye shes dbugs dbyung dang*// bzhi pa gzengs bstod par bcas sogs// mtshams sbyor brda sprod dang bcas te// snga ma'i rigs pas shes par bya/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /brgyad pa mjug gi cho ga ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos la// bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlabs te phyi nang yid byung bstod pa rnams bya/ yig brgya lan gsum dang ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ ras bris yin na phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i zhes sogs kyi mthar/ khyad par du yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhes sogs dang*/ rdul tshon gyi phyogs yin na// gshegs gsol gyi nyin ma gtogs pa'i nyi ma snga ma rnams la/ gong gi khyad par du yang zhes pa'i rjes su rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas bar du zhes sogs brjod la/

rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs (241)su gsol ba dang*// dam tshig pa bsdu ba sogs sta gon gyi skabs ltar bya'o// rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi nyin rjes chog gi tshe// bum pa rnams khyams kyi steng du bzhag la// cho ga gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ /ma 'byor pa dang thogs kyi rjes su/ bdag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ gtor mgron rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs byas la// oṃ khyed kyis sogs kyi mthar/ /mtheb srin gyi se gol byas te/ badz+ra muḥ rten la ma brten pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams dang*/ rdul tshon gyi ye shes pa dang*/ bum nang gi ye shes pa rnams chos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥrang la gnyis su med par thim oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod de nas rol mo dang bcas pas/ oṃ a kā ro muḥkhaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta ces dang*/ oṃ gi li gi li hūm̐ dzaḥzhes brjod cing de kho na nyid dran pas rdo rje'i rtses dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa dang por gshigs/ de nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas ci bde bar gshegs su gsol/ rdul tshon 'dod pa yod na lha'i mtshan ma nas blangs la sbyin/ gzhan rnams mtha' nas rim pas bsdus te/ za ma tog la sogs par blugs la rdul tshon chu bor spyan drangs pa'i cho ga'am/ de tsam mi nus na bkur sti chen pos rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung ngam khron pa la sogs par gshegs su gsol la/ thig rjes ma rnams dri zhim po'i chus mtha' nas rim pa bzhin phyis te rjes mi mngon par byas la/ grub na skabs 'dir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya zhing*/ phyogs kun tu me tog gi sil mas gtor te bkra shis kyi glu dang*/ rol mo'i sgra sna tshogs dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am dpa' bo'i ston mo la sogs pas dga' ston rgya chen po byas nas chos dang mthun pa'i spyod pas gnas par bya'o// de ltar dges (242)pa rdo rje yi// dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa dang*// dbang bskur lam du byed pa'i thabs// 'di ni dbang chu mdzes rgyan yin// blo dman rnams la phan pa'i phyir// bdag nyid 'jug pa gtsor byas mod// legs par brtags na dbang chog kyang*// bde blag nyid du shes par 'gyur// tshig nyung gzung bde dgos pa tshang*// rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i rnam dbye phyed// mkhas rmongs kun gyi rnar snyan pa// 'di 'dra gang gis shes de mkhas// gong ma'i legs bshad la brten zhing*// dam pa'i phyag bzhes mang mthong yang*// nongs gyur mchis na 'phags rnams la// sgo gsum sdig dang lhan cig bshags// legs par 'bad pa las byung ba'i// dge des mtha' yas 'gro ba kun// gsang chen lam bzang mthar phyin nas// rgyal ba'i phrin las kun sgrubs shog

/ces dbang gi chu bo chen mo lag tu blang ba'i rim par phye ba 'di ni/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha'i zhal snga nas gtso bor smos pa'i yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa mang po'i zhabs kyi rdul phreng rnyog pa med pa spyi bos blangs pa la brten nas/ rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras kyi gsung rab rin po che rnams kyi tshig don la shes nas dad pa thob pa'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis/ blo gsal don gnyer can mang pos bskul ba'i ngor dge byed ces pa chu pho stag gi lo snron gyi zla ba'i nyer lnga'i nyin/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi ri khrod du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni/ lung rigs smra ba mgon po rin chen dpal bzang gis gus pas bgyis pa'o// 'di'i rgyab rten du dbang gi chu bo chen mo yang dang yang du blta bar gyis shig /slar yang tshig don gyi cha mi bde ba rnams rtsom pa po de nyid kyis cung zad bcos te dag par byas so// sarba maṅga laṃ/// /dge'o// dge'o/// /
